notes.title: Demo Version 0.7.2 – Patch Notes
notes.notes: [p]Hello again, Jack the Ripper players![/p][p]As we mentioned two weeks ago, we’re still dedicating a lot of development time to indoor combat features. We’re putting a great deal of thought and effort into combat inside interior spaces, and we’ll be revealing it soon. In the meantime, we’ve enabled early access to the church in the Graveyard area. If you’re interested, please drop by and check it out![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630901/db008bfd97c531dfbc78aee8a4f023a83d84a1f5.png"][/img][/p][h3]Other Changes[/h3][olist][*][p]Added firearm VFX & SFX: More polished![/p][/*][*][p]Updated UI on player death.[/p][/*][*][p]Whitechapel polish: more detailed, richer set dressing throughout the city.[/p][/*][*][p]Training Grounds re-entry from the lobby: the door to the original shooting-practice spot now opens—you can rewatch the projector film.[/p][/*][*][p]Citizen vs. police pathing: when their paths conflict, they now yield instead of getting into a standoff.[/p][/*][*][p]If you leave a weapon slot empty, the HUD’s weapon info now shows the empty slot as well.[/p][/*][*][p]Player death screams toned down (reduced intensity/volume).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where using the Regeneration Syringe in a specific order left a ghost item in the quickslot after use.[/p][/*][*][p]Switching weapons during reload now cancels the reload and switches as expected.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the intro message shown when entering Whitechapel for the first time after finishing the tutorial.[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial minigame countdown now displays 3-2-1 (instead of 1-2-3).[/p][/*][*][p]Hunter Coin price display now always shows the coin icon before the number.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor improvements to the Hunter tab UI.[/p][/*][*][p]Press H to hide the HUD.[/p][/*][/olist][h3]Work in Progress[/h3][olist][*][p]Interior (“motel” concept) set dressing and indoor combat.[/p][/*][*][p]Item to manually load rounds: you can test it inside the church. (Tip: don’t bring a weapon when you go to the church!)[/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Demo Version 0.7.1 – Patch Notes
notes.notes: [p]Hello, Jack the Ripper players![/p][p]As we’re dedicating a lot of development time to indoor combat features, this update is relatively small in scope. We’ll be unveiling much more exciting content soon.[/p][p]Stay tuned![/p][p][/p][h3]Features[/h3][olist][*][p]Whitechapel area development: added a Hospital, installed gas lamps at the Police Station, added grass/foliage, and more.[/p][/*][*][p]Street names are now displayed on the minimap.[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon art updated (chunkier silhouettes, emphasized reload frames).[/p][/*][*][p]Added VFX for gunfire (muzzle flash) and shell casing ejections.[/p][/*][*][p]Lobby: top tab menu is now center-aligned.[/p][/*][*][p]Projector film: dialogue can be skipped, and other UI is hidden during playback.[/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Demo Version 0.7.0 – Patch Notes
notes.notes: [h3]Major Features[/h3][olist][*][p]Consumable items used in Whitechapel will no longer be re-supplied.[/p][/*][*][p]Carriage escape is now blocked if there are witnesses or monsters nearby.[/p][/*][*][p]Hunter Coins will not drop below zero even when reduced by mission penalties.[/p][/*][*][p]Grisler’s attack skill now inflicts a bleeding effect.[/p][/*][/olist][h3]Minor Improvements[/h3][olist][*][p]Merged the Hunter tab and the Shop tab in the lobby.[/p][/*][*][p]The UI now indicates that Q and E can be used to switch tabs in the lobby.[/p][/*][*][p]Polished the Whitechapel field HUD UI.[/p][/*][*][p]The lobby map UI can no longer move horizontally.[/p][/*][*][p]Partial renewal of several Whitechapel buildings (Police Station, Hospital, Residential houses).[/p][/*][*][p]Full gameplay logs are now recorded (to aid issue reporting).[/p][/*][/olist][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][olist][*][p]Fixed an issue where the health bar did not accurately reflect current HP when it was nearly depleted (applies to both player and bosses).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where police officers sometimes remained in the street after death under certain conditions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where Grisler appeared as “Unknown” in Stats → My Battle History.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where Grisler’s tail remained after death.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where Grisler sometimes failed to descend from the air.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where items assigned to quick slots in the lobby were not preserved when entering Whitechapel.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the boss rage effect did not clear upon the boss’s death.[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced “$” with the Hunter Coin icon on the Debriefing screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the lobby Hunter Coin UI displayed “$” when the held Hunter Coin amount became negative.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the escape timer’s circular gauge started partially filled.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the positions of quick-slot items consumed in Whitechapel changed after returning to the lobby.[/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Demo Version 0.6.9 – Patch Notes
notes.notes: [h3]Major Features[/h3][olist][*][p]Overall quality upgrade for Grisler[/p][/*][*][p]Added boss Rage & Groggy (stagger) system[/p][/*][/olist][h3]Minor Improvements[/h3][olist][*][p]Added a feature to reissue supply gear when you’ve lost all weapons and lack funds to repurchase[/p][/*][*][p]Added Grisler leaderboard[/p][/*][*][p]Minimap quality improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Overall UI rework[/p][/*][*][p]ESC key now closes the Stage Summary popup[/p][/*][/olist][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][olist][*][p]Fixed an issue where unequipping a weapon in the lobby made it impossible to equip it again[/p][/*][*][p]In the lobby shop, item details are now cleared when changing categories[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed unnatural leftover pixels during the Tarnished Slaves jump-skill animation[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed citizens becoming invincible after receiving a knockback attack[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed citizens spawning more than intended[/p][/*][/olist][h3]Balance Changes[/h3][p][i]L.C. Smith[/i][/p][list][*][p]Damage: 420 → 360[/p][/*][*][p]Spread angle: 10 → 24[/p][/*][*][p]Pellet count: 12 → 24[/p][/*][*][p]Effective range: 150 → 62[/p][/*][*][p]Collision size: 4 → 2.5[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Version 0.6.8 – Patch Notes
notes.notes: [h3][b]New Features[/b][/h3][olist][*][p][b]New Boss: “Grisler”[/b][/p][/*][/olist][h3][b]Bug Fixes & Minor Improvements[/b][/h3][olist][*][p]Lowered the effectiveness of the Player’s Persistence Potion (duration 120s → 30s).[/p][/*][*][p]Added screen brightness adjustment.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated minimap background and carriage icon.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the instructor’s first line wouldn’t advance with a single input.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where taking damage during a roll could leave the character stuck on the final roll animation frame.[/p][/*][*][p]Path guidance created by the Vision Potion and corpse piles now also appears on the minimap.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed stereo sound not being applied correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]If you die while carrying the evidence item (Cursed Essence), it now drops at the death location.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where an incorrect title could be awarded if the tutorial minigame exceeded 1 minute.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions, the door at the tutorial start would not open.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Q/E hotkeys to switch lobby tabs.[/p][/*][*][p]Pressing ESC in the lobby now first switches to the Play tab; if already on Play, it shows the Quit popup.[/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Demo Version 0.6.7 – Patch Notes
notes.notes: [h3]Minor Additions[/h3][olist][*][p]Added [b]Vision Potion[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted navigation so civilians, police, and bosses can now move through narrower paths.[/p][/*][/olist][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][olist][*][p]Fixed an issue where parts of the weapon disappeared when aiming downward.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in which monster traces vanished during combat situations unrelated to the player.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed certain civilians that bullets would pass through without registering hits.[/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Demo Version 0.6.6 – Patch Notes
notes.notes: [h3]Minor Additions[/h3][olist][*][p]Softened the outline of the fog-of-war (vision blocker) effect[/p][/*][*][p]Added a ping effect to corpse-pile markers on the minimap for better visibility[/p][/*][*][p]Player-death UI now warns that all gear and consumables are lost on death[/p][/*][*][p]Added a Credits button to the lobby’s Settings tab[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial minigame intro dialogue is skipped from the second playthrough onward[/p][/*][*][p]Placed a leaderboard board at the tutorial minigame’s finish point[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized performance of the tutorial stage[/p][/*][*][p]Enriched the Whitechapel stage with additional details[/p][/*][*][p]Win/Mac: Reduced crosshair input latency[/p][/*][*][p]Win/Mac: The exit popup can now be closed with the ESC key[/p][/*][*][p]Win/Mac: NPC dialogue can now be advanced with Space, Enter, or F keys[/p][/*][/olist][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][olist][*][p]Fixed citizens colliding and becoming mutually stuck[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the hit-flash effect not playing on the final strike[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected subtitles and line breaks where projector film audio and captions were out of sync[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed weapon aim direction becoming unnatural at the start/end of event dialogue and immediately after entering Whitechapel[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed character colors appearing brighter than intended[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the tutorial door-opening sound playing even when sound effects are disabled[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed being able to change weapons via the UI after the player dies[/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Demo Version 163 – Patch Notes
notes.notes: [h3]General[/h3][olist][*][p]Adjusted the Whitechapel fog color so it now looks identical on every platform.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the roll distance could occasionally be shorter than intended.[/p][/*][*][p]Bullets no longer pass straight through policemen; they now register hits correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Projectiles now fire exactly in the cross-hair’s aiming direction.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the weapon-swap button so it works properly in Whitechapel.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed debug UI from the corpse piles that indicated boss locations.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the default renderer from [b]Vulkan[/b] to [b]DirectX 12[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected untranslated text in the stage-entry pop-up UI.[/p][/*][/olist][h3]The Training Compound[/h3][olist][*][p]Added an outline effect to highlight interactive targets.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a title on the mini-game results pop-up based on your score.[/p][/*][*][p]Mini-game rankings can now be viewed on the Statistics tab of the Lobby screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed untranslated text in the mini-game results pop-up UI.[/p][/*][*][p]All targets now reset properly when the mini-game starts.[/p][/*][*][p]Control instructions now display correctly for PC settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Refined the control-highlight effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the instructor spawning beneath the watchtower.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected untranslated text on the rolling (dodge) poster.[/p][/*][/olist]
